title: An in-flight state a criterion names needs a test that holds the request open
rule: When a criterion names a state that exists only while a request runs ('Checking…', 'Connecting…', 'Saving…'), add a test that holds the request on a promise the test releases (restore any existing spy first and wrap the real method, so the spy does not call itself), asserts the in-flight text and the disabled control, then releases it and asserts the final state. Tests that only await the end state pass when the in-flight branch is deleted.
rationale: E57.7 (#697): the 'Checking for updates…' title of the About status row had no test; every test awaited the result of the check.
